resource.why: We're rolling out an updated PlanetScale Postgres image for your branch's Postgres version. Applying it requires restarting Postgres, so we do it during your maintenance window.
resource.expected_impact: Each Postgres instance restarts once, replicas first. If your branch has replicas, we switch the primary over to an updated replica before restarting it: open connections to the primary are dropped and writes pause briefly while the switchover completes. If your branch has no replicas, Postgres is unavailable while it restarts, usually for under a minute. Make sure your application reconnects and retries.
